payload.model_text:
---- MODULE DeclaredUIState ----
EXTENDS Integers, FiniteSets, Sequences, TLC

\* translator: state-transition-ir-to-tla (tla-compiler/v1)
\* source_document_id: bafkreieqe2rszlmc3bhcwhhi4c7rubtte5uacocwgpkcfaga4ijn2tkuyu
\* source_kind: state_transition_ir
\* finite bounds: steps<=64,vars<=64,actions<=128,int=[0,7]

MaxSteps == 64

\* @type: Set;
ui_stateDomain == {"state_0", "state_1"}

VARIABLES
    ui_state,
    step

vars == <<ui_state, step>>

TypeOK ==
    /\ ui_state \in ui_stateDomain
    /\ step \in 0..MaxSteps

Init ==
    /\ step = 0
    /\ ui_state = "state_1"  \* pred:ui-init

UIEvent0 ==
    /\ ui_state = "state_1"
    /\ ui_state' = "state_0"

Next ==
    /\ step < MaxSteps
    /\ UIEvent0
    /\ step' = step + 1


Safety ==
    /\ TypeOK


BoundedProgress ==
    <>(step = MaxSteps)

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

====
